perspective:
Bradley Ochoa’s available information:

- He knows he is Bradley Ochoa, a salesperson, and that Katherine Lasiloo is his colleague and the marketing manager. Their professional relationship has had some tension over sales versus marketing strategy.
- In the initial meeting room discussion, he has prepared data and charts from the last five campaigns. He tells Katherine he appreciates her digital strategies but believes traditional sales methods are being overlooked and better support core sales. He hears Katherine say the market is evolving, digital outreach has potential, and asks how he reconciles his data with rising online engagement. He clarifies he is not against digital marketing—he is frustrated that proven traditional methods are being sidelined. Katherine says she understands and proposes analyzing the data together to integrate both approaches.
- After the meeting, Katherine shares recent digital campaign success stories with significantly boosted engagement and sales. Bradley asks how those strategies are developed. Katherine says it is about targeting the right audience with the right message and offers to walk him through the analytics and decision-making behind a recent campaign; they agree to examine the data further. Bradley admits he had doubts about moving away from traditional methods but now wants to understand the digital approach.
- Bradley proposes a joint strategy meeting to combine traditional and digital marketing. Katherine agrees, says combining strengths could lead to better results, and suggests scheduling time to brainstorm and outline next steps. Bradley says he is hopeful and appreciates her willingness to collaborate. Katherine says she looks forward to leveraging each other’s strengths and making it happen.
- After a successful joint meeting, Bradley is excited and works overtime on a board presentation draft that integrates both their ideas. He tells Katherine about it. Katherine reviews it, calls it comprehensive and well thought out, and praises his hard work. Bradley says he is convinced the integrated approach will set them apart from competitors and wants to nail the presentation. Katherine says she is confident and suggests going through it once more to fine-tune.
- After their presentation succeeds and the integrated strategy is implemented, Bradley thanks Katherine, says he has learned a lot, and feels grateful for his growth through their collaboration. Katherine says it has been a pleasure and that his openness to new ideas made the partnership successful. Bradley proposes regular strategy sessions. Katherine agrees, saying they will keep them on top of their game and market trends.

He has access to these events and statements because he directly participated in, observed, heard, or said them. He does not have access to narrator-only summaries or other characters’ private thoughts unless those were expressed to him.
